end.parentNote: Asha practised number-line jumps and finding partners that make 100. Vihaan explained 80 + 20 using tens and counted forward from 46 to 50; these methods went well. Vihaan mixed up the partner for 65, and the mix-up was still present at the end. At home, practise pairs such as 65 + 35 by checking both the tens and ones, then counting on to 100.
